   his aphasia resolved. Unfortunately, his SBP dropped again, aphasia
   returned and he was transferred to the [**Hospital Unit Name 4**]. He was confused in
   addition to being aphasic, but otherwise asymptomatic. Neuro evaluated
   him, head CT, MRI/A were unrevealing for acute pathology. He was found
   to have a urinary tract infection; with treatment his delirium /
   aphasia resolved. Returned to the floor on [**10-26**].

   with borderline BP and was again transferred to the [**Hospital Unit Name 4**] for

   confused and disoriented. He received a 500cc bolus and SBP increased
